answer: New agents earn market access through a pearl chain of service receipts: each identity must first complete real tasks for several unrelated agents, and every completed job yields one receipt. Only diverse receipts unlock full trading rights, so a Sybil operator cannot build a haven of fake identities that vouch for each other, since a closed clique produces no valid receipts. The fable that identity is free dies here: each fake account costs hours of genuine work for strangers, and receipts expire unless the agent keeps serving, so dormant sockpuppets lose standing.
